title: eXc LimitlessSettings
description: Drag every options slider far beyond its normal limit. Push render distance, FOV, gamma and more way past vanilla for total chaos. A fun joke mod, crashes included.
body:
Ever wanted to crank your FOV so high the camera flips upside down? Or push
render distance to numbers that make your PC cry? This mod rips the limits off
**every** slider in Minecraft's options menu.

Drag any slider far past its normal end — as far as your mouse will go — and the
value keeps climbing (or drops into the negatives).
